explanation: Map every original node to its new copy before visiting its neighbors. This breaks recursive cycles and preserves adjacency while sharing no original graph nodes.
timeComplexity: O(V + E) expected time for reachable vertices V and directed adjacency entries E.
spaceComplexity: O(V) map/recursion space, plus O(V + E) cloned output.
